value.title: Deflakes must preserve shutdown ordering

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR319 R1 at f382cc0: the scaled PID-gone wait passed deterministic live/gone controls and five real fixture tests. A no-wait mutant failed both deterministic controls. The daemon_stop change weakened its oracle: an isolated mutation awaited HTTP serving/drain completion, delayed 200 ms, then released control, yet the test passed in 6.09 s. is_finished checked only inside while has-session can be skipped when the session disappears; a timeout after that loop cannot bound the loop itself. Require a bounded full observation and a success-path ordering proof. After restoring production bytes, all eight controls passed again. Zombie/reused PID checks conservatively keep files; socket absence or successful kill-server is not death proof. Diagnostics print the configured wait, not actual elapsed. Difficulty: long serialized build waits. MagicWand: retain the wrong-order mutation as an explicit negative control whenever deflaking this test.
